institutional_core.mission: Develop and implement the MFA training strategy and support professional development of ministry and mission staff throughout their careers.
institutional_core.governance: An organisational unit of the Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
institutional_core.programme_model: Induction, preparatory service, Career Diplomat Programmes, pre-posting, specialist, soft-skills, e-learning and language-development provision.
institutional_core.learning_model: Career-stage professional formation combining diplomatic/consular preparation, specialist training, language proficiency and international exchange opportunities.
institutional_core.assessment_model: The Academy organises the Diplomatic and Consular Exam and manages language proficiency verification/exams.
institutional_core.professional_practice_model: Pre-posting training is tailored to prospective responsibilities in diplomatic missions abroad.
institutional_core.international_cooperation_model: The Academy collaborates with domestic/international training institutions, foreign ministries and international organisations and facilitates exchange programmes for foreign officials.
institutional_core.credential_model: The Diplomatic and Consular Exam is linked to entry into the career diplomatic path and receipt of the first diplomatic rank; this dossier does not infer broader credential authority beyond the source.
institutional_core.digital_transparency_model: Official MFA pages identify the Academy, management, training functions and contact route.
distinctive_practices: pre-posting training aligned to mission responsibilities
methodology_lessons_for_wpa: Career-stage architecture should remain visible in I06 rather than being collapsed into a generic programme count.
Formal professional examinations are stronger evidence for I08 than workshop attendance alone.
Pre-posting training provides a strong applied-practice signal for I11-I13.
International cooperation should be scored from documented functions/agreements, not from partnership name-dropping.
